title: SummationDONUTSMP
description: Instantly calculates and displays the total net worth of items in any inventory, chest, or Shulker Box! Perfect for DonutSMP.
body:
Tired of manually calculating the worth of your items on economy servers like **DonutSMP**? 
Introducing **SummationDONUTSMP** – the fastest, most lightweight Client-Side mod for Minecraft 1.21.x that instantly calculates the exact total value of your inventories! 💸
## 🔥 Key Features
- ✨ **Instant Value Calculation:** Open any inventory (Chest, Ender Chest, Inventory) and see your total net worth instantly rendered dynamically on the right side of the screen!
- 📦 **Deep Shulker Scanning:** It automatically looks inside your Shulker Boxes to give you an exact, flawless total. No hidden items will be left uncounted.
- ⚡ **Extreme Performance:** Zero lag! Built with a highly optimized, smart LRU-caching system designed for massive storages and rapid movements.
- 🎯 **Modern & Adaptive UI:** Features a sleek, dynamic overlay that automatically scales with your Minecraft GUI Scale, backed by a semi-transparent dark box for perfect readability in any biome.
- 🌐 **Multi-Language Support:** Automatically adjusts text to English or Polish based on your Minecraft client language settings.
## ⚙️ How It Works
The mod actively scans the tooltips (lore) of items for the specific format `Worth: $$$`. It supports numerical suffixes like `K`, `M`, and `B` (e.g., `$32.04K` or `1.5M`).
You can toggle the overlay at any time using the `O` key (rebindable in controls).
## 🛠️ Installation
Simply drop the `.jar` file into your `mods` folder.
**Requirements:**
- Fabric Loader 0.16.2+
- Fabric API (Minecraft 1.21.x)
